# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $100

**Best overall: Anker Soundcore Space Q45, about $99**
- RTINGS ranks it the best budget ANC headphone it has tested. It quiets engine rumble and chatty coworkers better than the rest.
- Battery life is a point of disagreement. RTINGS measured about 28 hours, while CartIQ lists 50 hours with ANC off and 38 with it on. Treat the higher figures cautiously.
- Some owners report the headband cracking over time.
- Review and buy links: [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones) and [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)

**Best newer pick: Soundcore Space One, $99.99**
- Best Products named it their top pick under $100. They cite adaptive ANC, balanced sound, a good app, and rotating, comfortable ear cups.
- Its battery is rated 55 hours with ANC off and 40 with it on. It has no sweat resistance, so it's not for workouts.
- Dealectric says code AFSC20 took $19.99 off at Soundcore's US store (about $80) when they tested it on 2026-10-22. The code expires 2026-12-31 and doesn't apply to items already on sale. Checkout has the final word on price.
- [Buy at Soundcore via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you.

**Best cheap with strong ANC: Anker Soundcore Life Q20 (2024)**
- RTINGS says it nearly matches the Q45's noise isolation for less money, with 49 hours of battery.
- It's weaker on bass rumble, and the plastic build creaks and the earpads can flake.
- I don't have a current price for it. [RTINGS review](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)

**Lightest option: Sony WH-CH720N, $99**
- It weighs 192g and uses Sony's V1 processor. It supports only SBC and AAC, with no LDAC.
- [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)

**Cheaper options**
- **Edifier Atom Max, about $45:** Best Products' budget pick, with up to 44 dB of hybrid ANC and 45 hours of battery. [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)
- **Edifier W820NB Plus, $79:** plush earcups, LDAC, and 49 hours of battery, but no case. [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)
- **1MORE SonoFlow SE, $65:** 70-hour battery, but weaker ANC and no app. [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)
- **JBL Tune 760NC, $79:** a bass-heavy sound and the best mic of the group for calls, though its ANC is middling. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/over-ear-headphones-under-100) and [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)

**My pick:** The Space One at about $80 with the code is the best value, if the code still works at checkout. Otherwise, get the Q45 if noise blocking matters most, or the Edifier Atom Max if you want to spend as little as possible.

Prices change often, so check the retailer before buying. The links above are review pages and one retailer link, and I couldn't verify live prices on Amazon or Best Buy.
